messages:
maria_support: Fwd from customer (Acme Payments): after yesterday's model push to v3.3-canary they say the assistant's replies have become noticeably pared-down — fewer examples, shorter sentences. They also hit intermittent 504s on /v1/generate around 2023-11-12T14:05:05Z. Customer included a short convo and wants us to investigate.

maria_support: sample customer snippet (copied):
> user: How do I update my billing method?
> assistant: Go to Billing > Payment Methods and update.
> user: Can you show steps?
> assistant: Open Billing. Click Payment Methods. Done.
> (customer says previous behavior included step-by-step with screenshots/examples)

deploy-bot: Canary rollout recorded: v3.3-canary -> 10% traffic @ 2023-11-12T13:58:40Z. No automatic rollback triggered.

raj_engineer: Noted. Two threads: 1) shorter responses (quality) 2) 504s (infra). Anyone have request ids or example request payloads from Acme? That helps repro.

maria_support: I asked them for full request logs and a couple of request_ids. They sent one ID: rq_8f3b2a from 2023-11-12T14:05:04Z. Also provided their client-side curl they use.

sre_oncall: seeing a small spike in p95 latency around 2023-11-12T14:04–14:07Z in the us-east region. Some worker restarts on hosts gpu-rt-12. Linking grafana: https://grafana.redwood.internal/d/latency/rolling?from=1699790000000&to=1699790400000

raj_engineer: For the output brevity: can be sampling params, system prompt change, or a lightweight model variant being routed. Check routing logs for that request_id to confirm model instance used. Also, verify that max_tokens or stop sequences weren't accidentally set by customer client.

aoife_product: We changed routing config for canary to prefer smaller quantized variants for latency-sensitive workloads. That could explain terser tone if the quantized variant was present. But we didn't change system prompts. I'll check the rollout config.

maria_support: Customer's curl (as-provided):
```
curl https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \ 
  -H "Authorization: Bearer sk-acme-xyz" \ 
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \ 
  -d '{"model":"assistant-3.2","input":"How do I update my billing method?","temperature":0.0,"max_tokens":50}'
```
They say they used same client before/after.

raj_engineer: Temperature=0.0 and max_tokens=50 will produce terse output. Did customer previously use a higher temp or higher max_tokens? Also model string says assistant-3.2 which is odd since canary routing could have swapped to assistant-3.3-canary on our side. Need routing entry for rq_8f3b2a.

sre_oncall: routing trace for rq_8f3b2a: routed -> us-east-1 -> pool:dedicated-canary -> runtime:assistant-3.3-q8 (quantized) on host gpu-rt-12. That host had a recycle ~14:04:58Z. 504 ~14:05:05Z correlates.

raj_engineer: That confirms quantized variant served the request. Quantized kernels may shorten outputs if combined with sampling=0 or low max_tokens? Unclear, but we should reproduce locally with exact payload and model binary. I'll pull the model and run inference on local CPU with same params.

aoife_product: Action: pause canary routing to quantized variant for Acme tenant and route them back to non-quantized for now. If confirmed, we'll roll back config for canary.

maria_support: I asked customer to rerun with temp=0.7 and max_tokens=150 and send results. Also asked for the full transcript and any timestamps. They replied they can test later today.

raj_engineer: For internal repro, please run this script (replace MODEL_BIN):
```bash
python repro.py --model MODEL_BIN --input "How do I update my billing method?" --temperature 0.0 --max_tokens 50
```
Capture logits and tokens to check for early termination or truncated generation.

sre_oncall: I'll mark the event as P2 for infra until we confirm if the host restarts caused tokenization/KV cache state loss. Host logs attached: gpu-rt-12: kubelet restarted container runtime due to OOMKill at 14:04:57Z.

raj_engineer: OOM+restarts can cause incomplete outputs if the runtime didn't flush cache correctly. Combined with a quantized kernel edge-case we might see shorter outputs. Steps: repro locally with quantized binary, inspect for early stop tokens, run with temp>0 to check stochasticity.

aoife_product: I'm reverting the tenant routing for Acme to non-quantized now and pausing traffic to assistant-3.3-q8. Will update in 5m.

deploy-bot: Routing update applied for tenant acme: prefer assistant-3.2-stable @ 2023-11-12T14:20:30Z. Canary quantized weight set to 0 for this tenant.

maria_support: Customer confirmed after we reverted routing they got longer, more explanatory replies again. They also said the 504s stopped. They appreciate quick response.

raj_engineer: I'll keep this open until we reproduce deterministically. If repro succeeds, we'll open a bug in eng-runtime to handle graceful degradation on worker restarts and check quantized generation correctness.

maria_support: Thanks team — escalating to eng-runtime with rq_8f3b2a and host logs. I'll ping once customer sends their extra runs. :thumbsup:

raj_engineer: Assigned to eng-runtime. ETA: start triage today EOD.
